_meta._note: Chapter 39, final test (ch39-test, new). Added 2026-10-03 in the proposal harvest, batch 3 (Docs/proposals/proposal-harvest-tracker.md), from Docs/proposals/chapter-39-content-proposal.md and its review amendments. Twelve multiple-choice questions on six two-question strands: 106:1 (q01–02), 106:2 (q03–04), 106:3 (q05–06), 106:4 (q07–08), two whole-reading evidence decisions (q09–10) and the two narrow retrievals — the season nouns are not a dual (q11) and the referent of ـهُمْ (q12). The selected 'accustomed security' rendering bounds q02; no distractor is a recognised alternative rendering. No route history, tafsir or finer parsing. Pass mark 80 %: 9/12 fails, 10/12 passes. Answer positions 3/3/3/3, no repeating cycle. Lessons 1–5 were already corrected (only words from 106:1–4, qāfila marked as outside the surah, آمَنَهُمْ with the local sense, إِيلَاف's renderings attributed); two over-teaching lines about the lām of command were softened to a supplied chunk, because that form is Chapter 68's.
